# The whip's wind-up hurts the Giant Spider with no wait (851-3463, docs/quirks.md §1), and the wiki clip
# quirks/giant-spider-whip-wind-up. The scene of the clip giant-spider/wind-up
# (wiki/clips/giant-spider/wind-up.toml), written by wiki-clips --replays (docs/wiki-media.md): it boots,
# loads this custom level from the title's load-level menu (240), and plays the scene's inputs from 241, its
# frame 0. The Giant Spider (S, with open rows above it, so an oGiantSpider on the ground, not a hanging one)
# is behind the player (@), who faces away from it:
#   1111111111111111111111
#   1000000000000000000001  (seven rows of this)
#   100000000S000000000001
#   10000000000@0000000001
#   1111111111111111111111
#   1111111111111111111111
# He swings the Whip (245). oGiantSpider's collision with the whip (oWhip) hurts it only while whipped is 0
# and then sets it to 10, a wait between hits; its create event sets it to 10 too, counting down from 240. But
# it has no collision with the wind-up behind the player (oWhipPre) of its own, so it takes oEnemy's: 1 a step
# with no wait, 10 to 9, 8 and 7 on three steps in a row (246-248), while whipped is still 3, 2 and 1. It
# leaps on him (254, 2 hearts).
